cards.ex: He was supposed to do the dishes, but his sister got him off the hook.
cards.exUz: U idishlarni yuvishi kerak edi, lekin singlisi uni qutqardi.
cards.uzDef: Bir vaziyatdan yoki majburiyatdan qutulish, ozod bo'lish.

cards.ex: As the team leader, she gets to call the shots.
cards.exUz: Jamoa rahbari sifatida u buyruq berishga haqli.
cards.uzDef: Vaziyatni nazorat qilish, qarorlar qabul qilish va nima qilish kerakligini aytish.

cards.ex: He hates being under his boss's thumb all the time.
cards.exUz: U doim xo'jayinining nazorati ostida bo'lishni yomon ko'radi.
cards.uzDef: Birovning nazorati ostida bo'lish, erksiz bo'lish.

cards.ex: She needed to break free from her boring routine.
cards.exUz: U zerikarli tartibidan ozod bo'lishi kerak edi.
cards.uzDef: Qamoqdan, cheklovlardan yoki qiyin vaziyatdan qutulish.

cards.ex: The artist was given free rein to design the mural.
cards.exUz: Rassomga devoriy rasmni loyihalashtirish uchun to'liq erkinlik berildi.
cards.uzDef: Nimadir qilish uchun to'liq erkinlikka ega bo'lish, hech kim aralashmasligi.

cards.ex: The animals were suffering in captivity at the zoo.
cards.exUz: Hayvonlar hayvonot bog'ida asirlikda azob chekishardi.
cards.uzDef: Ozodlikdan mahrum bo'lgan, qamoqda saqlanayotgan holat.

cards.ex: The new regulations put a straitjacket on small businesses.
cards.exUz: Yangi qoidalar kichik biznesga majburiy kamzul kiydirdi.
cards.uzDef: Har qanday erkinlikni cheklovchi, qiyin holat yoki qoidalar.

cards.ex: He threw off the shackles of his past and started a new life.
cards.exUz: U o'tmish kishanlarini tashladi va yangi hayot boshladi.
cards.uzDef: Erkinlikni cheklaydigan narsalar, ayniqsa metaforik ma'noda.

cards.ex: The teacher bent the rules a little to help the struggling student.
cards.exUz: O'qituvchi qiynalayotgan o'quvchiga yordam berish uchun qoidalarni biroz buzdi.
cards.uzDef: Qoidalarga to'liq rioya qilmasdan, ularni biroz o'zgartirish.

cards.ex: He thought he could get away with cheating on the test.
cards.exUz: U imtihonda aldash jazosiz qoladi deb o'yladi.
cards.uzDef: Noto'g'ri ish qilib, jazolanmaslik.

cards.ex: The government needs to keep a tighter leash on spending.
cards.exUz: Hukumat xarajatlarga qattiqroq jilov urishi kerak.
cards.uzDef: Nazorat, cheklov, erkinlikning yo'qligi.

cards.ex: You are at liberty to leave whenever you want.
cards.exUz: Qachon xohlasangiz ketishga haqlisiz.
cards.uzDef: Nimadir qilish uchun ruxsatga ega bo'lish, erkin bo'lish.

cards.ex: The wild horses roam free across the plains.
cards.exUz: Yovvoyi otlar tekisliklarda erkin kezib yurishadi.
cards.uzDef: Hech qanday cheklovlarsiz yoki qamoqsiz kezish, sayohat qilish.

cards.ex: The criminal slipped through the net and escaped.
cards.exUz: Jinoyatchi e'tibordan chetda qoldi va qochib ketdi.
cards.uzDef: E'tibordan qochish, aniqlanmaslik yoki jazolanmaslik.

cards.ex: The artist had unfettered access to the studio.
cards.exUz: Rassom studiyaga cheklanmagan kirish huquqiga ega edi.
cards.uzDef: Hech qanday cheklovlarsiz yoki to'siqlarsiz.

cards.ex: The soldiers liberated the town from the enemy.
cards.exUz: Askarlar shaharni dushmandan ozod qilishdi.
cards.uzDef: Birovni qamoqdan, zulmdan yoki cheklovdan ozod qilish.

cards.ex: The children ran wild in the park.
cards.exUz: Bolalar parkda boshqaruvsiz bo'lishdi.
cards.uzDef: Boshqaruvdan chiqib ketish, nazoratsiz harakat qilish.

cards.ex: He threw caution to the wind and invested all his money.
cards.exUz: U ehtiyotkorlikni unutdi va butun pulini sarmoya qildi.
cards.uzDef: Xavf-xatarlarga e'tibor bermaslik, tavakkal qilish.

cards.ex: The police officer always does everything by the book.
cards.exUz: Politsiyachi har doim hammasini qoidaga ko'ra qiladi.
cards.uzDef: Qoidalarga qat'iy rioya qilish, qonuniy yo'l bilan harakat qilish.

cards.ex: It's time to cut loose from this dead-end job.
cards.exUz: Bu bema'ni ishdan ozod bo'lish vaqti keldi.
cards.uzDef: Birovni yoki o'zingizni majburiyatlardan, aloqalardan ozod qilish.

cards.ex: The new project gave the team some breathing space.
cards.exUz: Yangi loyiha jamoaga nafas olish imkoniyatini berdi.
cards.uzDef: Stresssiz, erkin harakat qilish uchun vaqt yoki imkoniyat.

cards.ex: I need to free up some time to study for the exam.
cards.exUz: Imtihonga tayyorlanish uchun biroz vaqt bo'shatishim kerak.
cards.uzDef: Vaqt, resurs yoki joyni nimadir uchun bo'shatib qo'yish.

cards.ex: He took liberties with my personal belongings.
cards.exUz: U mening shaxsiy narsalarimga erksizlik qildi.
cards.uzDef: Hurmatsizlik qilish, ruxsatsiz erkin harakat qilish.

cards.ex: You need to get a grip and stop panicking.
cards.exUz: O'zingizni tutishingiz va vahima qilishingizni to'xtatishingiz kerak.
cards.uzDef: O'z his-tuyg'ularini nazorat qilish, vaziyatni boshqarish.

cards.ex: He was released on parole after serving ten years.
cards.exUz: U o'n yil xizmat qilganidan so'ng shartli ozodlikka chiqarildi.
cards.uzDef: Qamoqdan vaqtincha, shartli ravishda ozodlikka chiqarilgan.

cards.ex: It's a gift, no strings attached.
cards.exUz: Bu sovg'a, hech qanday majburiyatisiz.
cards.uzDef: Hech qanday shartlar yoki majburiyatlar yo'q.

cards.ex: She felt held back by her lack of confidence.
cards.exUz: U o'ziga bo'lgan ishonchsizligi tufayli ushlab turilganini his qildi.
cards.uzDef: Oldinga siljishga to'sqinlik qilish, cheklash.

cards.ex: The company's growth was constrained by a lack of funding.
cards.exUz: Kompaniyaning o'sishi mablag' etishmasligi bilan cheklangan edi.
cards.uzDef: Erkin harakat qilish yoki rivojlanish qobiliyati cheklangan.

cards.ex: That topic is out of bounds during the meeting.
cards.exUz: Ushbu mavzu yig'ilishda ta'qiqlangan.
cards.uzDef: Kirish yoki foydalanish ta'qiqlangan joy yoki mavzu.

cards.ex: The project was finally given the green light.
cards.exUz: Loyiha nihoyat ruxsat berildi.
cards.uzDef: Nimadir qilish uchun ruxsat olish, tasdiqlangan bo'lish.
